blocks.createmetalogistics:expansion_module.too: Linked to a compiler; shift+use to clear
Linked to a compiler in another dimension; shift+use to clear
Connects to compiler blocks (shift+use, up to %d blocks away) to allow larger inventories to be encoded
Additional items are listed in manifests generated in each expansion module, and can be distributed to readers as normal
blocks.createmetalogistics:filter_requester.too: Filtering variant of the Redstone Requester that accepts a single filter for item types, instead of up to 9 item types
blocks.createmetalogistics:station_chunk_loader: Linked to a train station; shift+use to clear
Linked to a train station in another dimension; shift+use to clear
Can temporarily load chunks in a 3x3 area when connected to a train station (up to %d blocks away)
blocks.createmetalogistics:ticket_crate.tooltip: Unlimited source of tickets for 9 (individual) item types, typically for use with request systems; place and open to configure
May be connected to a network frequency for generated tickets to inherit that network's owner attribute (origin network will always be N/A)
Clipboards can be used on this block to transfer required materials into a ticket
